newsitem.title: THAILAND: THAI STOCKS FALL 2.05 PCT ON FINANCE WOES.
newsitem.headline: THAI STOCKS FALL 2.05 PCT ON FINANCE WOES.

text.p: Thai stocks retreated 2.05 percent at noon as investors sold across the board on sustained market concerns over the future of suspended finance companies, brokers said on Thursday.
The composite SET index fell 13.00 points to 622.32 at 0500 GMT on thin 1.2 billion baht turnover. Most counters took the beating with banks and communications issues leading the decline.
"Foreigners used to be net buyers. But now they're selling as they don't have confidence in the Thai economy in near-term," said a broker.
Brokers said apart from worries over the economy, investors were also concerned about a government decision to raise the value added tax (VAT) to 10 percent from seven.
The SET index slipped further to 621.79, down 13.53 points or 2.13 percent, at 0513 GMT.
